title: Justice and the Courts
lead: The Bible's laws set up courts of elders, judges and priests and command them to judge fairly, take no bribes, require more than one witness and protect the weak (Exodus 23:1–8; Deuteronomy 16:18–20; 19:15–21). The prophets condemn courts that "turn justice into poison" (Amos 6:12) and look for a king who will judge the poor with righteousness (Isaiah 11:4).
